utility_bill.reason: Use the official national portal to find your state electricity provider; do not pay through a link in an unverified message.

pension.name: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority

identity_document.reason: Use the official UIDAI portal for Aadhaar services; never share an OTP with an unverified caller or site.

education_admission.name: University Grants Commission
education_admission.reason: Use the official UGC website to verify higher-education notices and student services.
